text: 作为一个四五年前相亲时，被各路长辈、红娘洗脑、打压、PUA的男生，我只想说：多年前射出去的子弹，多年后正中眉心！
en: As a man who, four or five years ago when matchmaking, was brainwashed, put down and PUA'd by various elders and matchmakers, I just want to say: the bullet fired many years ago hits right between the eyebrows many years later!

text: 我之前有过一个回答，大致描述了当年长辈、红娘们对我的洗脑和打压。
en: I previously gave an answer that roughly described the brainwashing and put-downs I received from elders and matchmakers back then.

text: 简而言之就是我985想找211、我181想找170、我长得算比较帅的所以想找漂亮点的、我25岁想找25岁以下、我公务员想找事业编打底、我家本地多房多车所以想找本地也有房车的门当户对点…
en: In short: I am from a 985 university and wanted someone from a 211; I am 181cm and wanted 170cm; I am fairly good-looking so wanted someone prettier; I was 25 and wanted someone under 25; I am a civil servant and wanted at least someone with a public-sector establishment; my family has plenty of local property and cars so I wanted a well-matched local partner who also had property and a car…

text: 然后红娘们对我的评价就是：你自身条件确实不差，你提的要求确实也符合“向下兼容”，但是，你的对手并不是女生，而是同样追求这个女生的其他男生。
en: Then the matchmakers' assessment of me was: your own conditions really aren't bad, and the requirements you set really do fit “downward compatibility”, but your rivals aren't the girls — they are the other boys pursuing the same girl.

text: 并且，同时满足你要求的女生，属于女生中的顶配中的顶配，有的是比你有钱的富二代追求，所以如果是相亲介绍，她们根本不可能考虑你。
en: Moreover, a girl who simultaneously meets all your requirements is the cream of the cream among girls; some have wealthier rich-second-generation suitors after them, so if it is through matchmaking introductions, they simply would not consider you.

text: 红娘对我的评价，也可以转化为这个问题的答案：
en: The matchmakers' assessment of me can also be turned into the answer to this question:

text: 40岁女，竞争对手并不是40岁男，而是30甚至25的女生。
en: A 40-year-old woman's competitors aren't 40-year-old men, but 30- or even 25-year-old girls.

text: 40岁女看不上的男的，现在有25左右的女生要，男的也不会考虑40岁女。
en: The men a 40-year-old woman looks down on are now wanted by girls around 25, and those men won't consider a 40-year-old woman either.

text: 40岁男人混的比较成功，他们更愿意选择18岁的姑娘。
en: The 40-year-old men who have done relatively well prefer to choose 18-year-old girls.

text: 40岁男人混的不成功，40岁的女人完全看不上混的不成功的男人。
en: The 40-year-old men who haven't done well are completely looked down on by 40-year-old women.

text: 我在知乎上极少数的几次生气开贴骂人，并表示会使用暴力手段对付的提问者和答主。
en: The very few times I got angry on Zhihu, opened a thread to abuse people and said I would use violent means against them, were aimed at certain questioners and answerers.

text: 她们都是做了同一件事——给40以上的成功男士，介绍老妪。
en: They all did the same thing — introducing old women to successful men over 40.

text: 侮辱社会成功人士。
en: Insulting successful people in society.

text: 现实中碰上这样的，我花钱找人来打。
en: If I met such a person in real life, I would pay someone to beat them up.

text: 行政拘留15天以内，能打多少打多少。
en: Within 15 days of administrative detention, I would beat them as much as I could.

text: 要是澳大利亚IP的话，花钱买雇佣兵过去打。
en: If it were an Australian IP, I would pay for mercenaries to go and beat them.

text: 就这个提问下的高赞，我会记得他的。
en: As for the top-voted answer under this question, I will remember him.

text: 还有一个就是男医生博士后，四十岁，那个提问者要帮自己40岁的表姐撮合他俩的。
en: There is also the one about a male doctor, a postdoc, forty years old, whose questioner wanted to matchmake him with her own 40-year-old cousin.

text: 我都记得的。
en: I remember all of them.

text: 前女友的妈妈都比你年轻
en: Your ex-girlfriend's mother is younger than you.

text: 最近和老家在京工作的一个大龄女相亲，对方外貌条件还不错，173的个头，虽然32了，但身材控制的不错，人淡如菊，长得有点像宋佳，总之就是75-80分的水平，…
en: Recently I went on a matchmaking date with an older woman working in the capital; her looks were decent — 173cm tall, and though she is 32, she keeps her figure well, is as calm and refined as a chrysanthemum, and looks a bit like Jia Song; all in all she was at a 75 to 80 out of 100 level…

text: 提出的条件如下：
en: The conditions she proposed were as follows:

text: 1.彩礼三十万。
en: 1. A bride price of three hundred thousand.

text: 2.我那辆理想one卖了加点钱给她买一辆奥迪Q5，正好和我的A6配对。
en: 2. Sell my Li Auto ONE and add some money to buy her an Audi Q5, which would pair nicely with my A6.

text: 3.婚前要新买一套房，写她名下，不然首套房资格浪费了，不过约定好我可以享有75%的产权。
en: 3. Before marriage, buy a new flat and put it in her name, otherwise the first-home eligibility would be wasted, but it was agreed I could hold 75% of the property rights.

text: 4.五金就免了，换成相对应的金条。
en: 4. Skip the five gold items, and replace them with equivalent gold bars.

text: 我仔细一盘算，除了房子问题有待商榷，其余都可以接受，于是多聊了一会。
en: After careful consideration, except for the housing issue which needed discussion, everything else was acceptable, so we chatted a bit longer.

text: 但不知怎么的，我突然鬼使神差的问了一句，毛毛（她弟弟，我俩媒人）也找对象，你希望找个啥样的啊？
en: But somehow, possessed by a strange impulse, I suddenly asked: Maomao (her younger brother, our matchmaker) is also looking for a partner — what kind of person would you hope he finds?

text: 我看上次那个李姐就挺不错的。
en: I thought that Sister Li from last time was quite good.

text: 结果，她不假思索的回了一句，太老了，我弟肯定得找个年轻的…
en: As a result, without thinking, she replied: too old, my brother definitely needs to find someone younger…

text: 顿时我俩都不说话了，大眼瞪小眼…
en: Instantly neither of us spoke; we just stared at each other wide-eyed…

text: 过后…
en: Afterwards…

text: 自然是没有过后了，两个人都默契的没有互相联系了。
en: Naturally there was no afterwards; the two of us tacitly stopped contacting each other.

text: 说真的，我还挺喜欢她这种坦率的性格…
en: To be honest, I rather liked her frank personality…

text: 记得被邻居阿姨介绍了个30岁左右的离异二婚，见面第一句话，你和你妈住一起，裤头谁洗？
en: I remember being introduced by a neighbour auntie to a roughly 30-year-old divorced, remarrying woman, whose first words on meeting were: you live with your mum, so who washes the underpants?

text: 30岁离异的都知道问这个了，你觉得40岁问嘛？
en: A 30-year-old divorcee already knows to ask this — do you think a 40-year-old wouldn't?

text: 女的上了岁数，经验阅历多了，更难相处和在一起。
en: As women get older, with more experience and worldly wisdom, they become harder to get along with and be with.

text: 上面这种问题，相亲见过的30来岁单身的从来没问过，年纪轻的也没问过。
en: None of the thirtysomething singles I have met through matchmaking ever asked questions like the above, nor did the younger ones.

text: 你以为她离异二婚就白给？
en: Do you think that because she is divorced and remarrying she is just a freebie?

text: 其实更加难以相处。
en: In fact she is even harder to get along with.

text: 很多事她和男人都住过了，都有经验了。
en: She has lived with men and experienced many things, so she knows it all.

text: 所以问的问题也跟大闺女不一样。
en: So the questions she asks are different from those of a young maiden.

text: 除非是那种没同居过，就干耗着的老姑娘。
en: Unless it is the kind of old maid who never cohabited and just waited it out.

text: 但这种女的更挑剔，10年20年都挑了，也不在乎继续挑挑。
en: But such women are even pickier; having already spent ten or twenty years choosing, they don't mind continuing to pick.

text: 男人找女人，无非两种，一种是性，一种是生育
en: Men look for women for only two reasons: one is sex, the other is childbirth.

text: 40岁女人大概率不能生孩子了
en: A 40-year-old woman most likely can't have children anymore.

text: 男人对40岁女人还有兴趣？
en: Do men still have any interest in 40-year-old women?

text: 所以，图什么呢
en: So what is one really after?

text: 可以先思考一个问，刘强东为什么不考虑董明珠？
en: First consider a question: why doesn't Qiangdong Liu consider Mingzhu Dong?

text: 再思考一个问题，男性结婚的目的是为了什么？
en: Then consider another question: what is a man's purpose in marrying?

text: 大多数是为传宗接代；
en: Mostly it is to carry on the family line;

text: 男性没钱40岁了，40岁的女性看不上；
en: A man with no money at 40 is looked down on by 40-year-old women;

text: 男性有钱40岁了优先找20岁的
en: A man with money at 40 gives priority to finding 20-year-olds.

text: 能被40岁女看上的40岁男，估计20岁女也能看上，而且这种男的一般不傻。
en: A 40-year-old man whom a 40-year-old woman fancies could probably also be fancied by a 20-year-old, and such men generally aren't foolish.

text: 这问题，问的好。
en: This question is a good one.

text: 先举个不恰当的列子吧。
en: First, let me give an inappropriate example.

text: 假如你年轻的时候，吃不上新鲜的水果。
en: Suppose that when you were young, you couldn't afford fresh fruit.

text: 每次路过水果摊，看到某种水果后，都会忍不住的流出口水。
en: Every time you passed a fruit stall and saw a certain fruit, you couldn't help but drool.

text: 但你知道，你兜里没有钱，买不起这种新鲜的水果。
en: But you knew you had no money in your pocket and couldn't afford this fresh fruit.

text: 你只好睁大眼睛，多看几眼水果。
en: You could only open your eyes wide and look at the fruit a few more times.

text: 过过眼瘾，，然后默默离开。
en: Satisfy your eyes, then leave silently.

text: 从此你心里暗自下决心，以后，有钱了，一定要买一个新鲜是水果尝尝，，
en: From then on you secretly made up your mind that in future, once you had money, you must buy a fresh fruit to try,

text: 看看新鲜水果到底是什么味道的。
en: to see what a fresh fruit actually tastes like.

text: 之后，就会出现两种情况。
en: After that, two situations will arise.

text: 第一种情况。
en: The first situation.

text: 20年后，你通过自己的努力，挣到了足够多的钱。
en: Twenty years later, through your own efforts, you have earned enough money.

text: 当你再次来到这个水果摊位的时候，发现，以前自己梦寐以求的水果，
en: When you come to this fruit stall again, you find that the fruit you once dreamt of,

text: 现在看得也不那么新鲜了，而且还有些枯萎的迹象，完全没有了当年的新鲜感。
en: now no longer looks so fresh, and even shows signs of wilting, completely losing the freshness of those days.

text: 反而，旁边新上市的水果，色泽鲜艳，口感鲜美，让人欲罢不能。
en: Instead, the newly launched fruit beside it is brightly coloured, delicious, and simply irresistible.

text: 凭你现在是实力，财力，完全可以拿下。
en: With your current prowess and financial means, you can easily win it.

text: 如果是你，你会选择哪个水果？
en: If it were you, which fruit would you choose?

text: 你不会告诉我选择那个，要过期的果子吧。
en: You aren't going to tell me you would choose that fruit about to expire, are you?

text: 第二种情况，，
en: The second situation,

text: 20年后，你还像当年那样，一贫如洗，没有积累多少财富。
en: Twenty years later, you are still as poor as you were back then, having accumulated little wealth.

text: 依然买不起水果。
en: You still can't afford fruit.

text: 当你走到，当年梦寐以求的水果摊位时，看了一眼那个快过期的水果。
en: When you walk to the fruit stall you once dreamt of, you glance at that nearly expired fruit.

text: 心理肯定犯起了嘀咕，想着，原来自己也没有那么喜欢这个水果 。
en: You will surely mutter to yourself, thinking: so I didn't actually like this fruit that much.

text: 当看到，新鲜上市的水果，那种感觉突然又来了，那是初恋的感觉。
en: When you see the freshly launched fruit, that feeling suddenly returns — it is the feeling of first love.

text: 虽然你还是没有钱，你也可能买不起这种水果，，
en: Although you still have no money and might not be able to afford this fruit,

text: 但，这并不影响你，追着新鲜水果，看来看去。
en: that doesn't stop you from following the fresh fruit with your eyes, looking it up and down.

text: 上下打量。
en: Sizing it up and down.

text: 心想，反正两种水果，自己都买不起，
en: Thinking to yourself: anyway, you can't afford either fruit,

text: 还不如多看看这个新鲜水果，，，给自己的生活增添点，
en: so you might as well look at this fresh fruit more, to add a bit to your life,

text: 新活力，新希望呢。
en: some new vitality and new hope.

text: 你们说不是这个道理呢？
en: Don't you think that is the truth?

text: 本故事纯属虚构，，请勿对号入座。
en: This story is entirely fictional, please don't take it personally.

text: 如有雷同纯属巧合。
en: Any resemblance is purely coincidental.

text: 请勿上纲上线。
en: Please don't read too much into it.

text: 谢谢。
en: Thank you.
